bean.name: CedarEntityUidExpression
bean.title: Cedar Entity Uid Expression
bean.description: Builds a Cedar EntityUID from a configured type and constant ID or exchange property, without constructing policy code.

entityType.description: Cedar entity type name, for example User or App::Document.

id.description: Constant entity identifier. Configure exactly one of id and exchangeProperty.

exchangeProperty.description: Exchange property containing the entity identifier as a String. Configure exactly one of id and exchangeProperty. A verified identity must be populated by authentication before this expression runs.
